[[The Matriarch's Stinger]] is a [[unique item|unique]] [[spear]] dropped by [[Spider Matriarch]], a [[boss]] who can be found in [[Arachni's Haunt]].

==Stats== 
:[[Piercing damage]]: 14-27 (Requires 9 [[Spear Mastery]])
:[[Damage]] +15% (while [[Health]] is above 50%)
:Lengthens [[Dazed]] durations on foes by 33% (Stacking)
:[[Health]] +30

==Skin==
This item uses the same [[skin]] as an [[Ornate Spear]] [[dye]]d white.
